message: PctChrome (libs/components/widget/src/chrome.ts) writes a `host` block this read does not take as written
$reason: `host-name-on-a-presentation-role` with the host block kept in a constant and handed to the decorator by shorthand. ngc evaluates the constant and compiles its entries into the declaration (measured through ngc in partial mode); the scanner read no host here, and the named presentational host passed every point (measured by the review of this change). The gate does not evaluate expressions, so point 1 refuses a block it does not take as written.
